zh: 深圳迈瑞生物医疗电子股份有限公司

addr: 深圳市南山区高新技术产业园区科技南十二路迈瑞大厦
addrEn: Mindray Building, Keji 12th Rd South, Nanshan, Shenzhen
how: Meet at CMEF. No need to fly to Shenzhen. Their US office: 800 MacArthur Blvd, Mahwah NJ, 201-995-8000, about 40 min from 510.
risk: Lowest risk. Ask them to pass you to Mindray North America for the US price.
about: China's biggest medical device maker. Listed in Shenzhen (300760). 2025 revenue about ¥33bn, over half from outside China. Known for monitors, ultrasound and lab machines.
clients: Has its own US company, Mindray North America, in Mahwah, NJ
connect: US office: 201-995-8000 or 800-288-2121 (press 3 for orders), Mon–Fri 8:30–5:30 ET. Harris can call from NJ.
At CMEF: see the products at the booth, then ask to be passed to Mindray North America
fit: Can an engineer from the Mahwah office service us, and how fast?
Is this exact model FDA-cleared for the US, or a China-only version?
US price and service contract vs the booth price?
flags: Patent lawsuit filed Sept 2025 (Terason) trying to block US sales of some ultrasound models: ask if this model is affected. Old FDA warning letter (2012) to the US unit.
